resources.string: Your music, tuned to your ears
PAudio estimates how each of your ears hears through your own earphones, learns what sounds good to you, and shapes the sound of your music apps to match.
A short test plays quiet tones in each ear. You tap when you hear them. It takes about 7 minutes.
Compare a few pairs of sound and choose your favorite to fine-tune bass, presence and treble to your taste.
PAudio runs in the background and applies your personal sound to your music apps. It switches by itself when you change earphones.

PAudio is not a medical device. These results are estimates for music listening only and are not a medical diagnosis. Phones and earphones can\'t be calibrated like clinical equipment, so hearing loss that is equal across all frequencies can\'t be detected. If you notice changes in your hearing, ringing, or pain, see a doctor or audiologist.
PAudio shows a small notification while it is working in the background. It also lets you switch between Personalized and Original, or turn PAudio off, without opening the app.
PAudio needs its notification to keep working in the background.
Results are stored per listener. You can add more people later in Profiles.
